data.title: Food & Restaurant — Beginner · Lesson 4
data.subject: food
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Spoken) Hey, you ready for this? Let's go!

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
Let's eat… Vamos a comer  
At the beach… En la playa  
Feeling free… Sintiéndonos libres  
Under the sun, just you and me.

[Verse]
Sun's up, it's a perfect day,  
Waves are dancing, come on let's play.  
The waiter… El mesero  
Smiles at us, says, "What will you order?"  
The menu… La carta  
Is in my hand, so many choices.  
The appetizer… El aperitivo  
Looks so good, can't wait to try it.  
A drink… Una bebida  
To cool us down, nothing better.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
Let's eat… Vamos a comer  
At the beach… En la playa  
Feeling free… Sintiéndonos libres  
Under the sun, just you and me.

[Verse]
The main dish… El plato principal  
Is here at last, it looks so ideal.  
I take a bite, it's so divine,  
The flavors burst, like stars that shine.  
The tip… La propina  
We leave with joy, for service so fine.  
The kitchen… La cocina  
Works so hard, to make our meal bright.  
The apple… La manzana
